**Issue #3540 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3540: Patch: Stinkyscape+ E2, Burn and Toxic
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds **Burn** and **Toxic**: counters on Units and heroes that tick at the start of their owner's turn, and the damage riders that add to them or convert damage into them.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP2, SP3, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## The designer's words

```text
* **Burns (New Keyword)**
  * **Burns [int]**
  * **Burn**ed units/heroes take [int] *unpierced* damage at the start of their owners turn, then the burn is decremented by 3 *{eg burn 8 -> burn 5 -> burn 2 -> no burn}*
  * Can also get *Damage dealt Burns* which converts all damage to **Burn**
* **Toxic (New Keyword)**
  * **Toxic [int]**
  * **Toxic** units/heroes take [int] *pierce* damage at the start of their owners turn in perpetuity
  * Can also get *Damage dealt is Toxic* which converts all damage to **Toxic**
```

## The build (defaults from SP3; change one only with a ruling note)

- Both are counters on a Unit or a hero, shown on the card and the hero. **Default:** a new Burn or Toxic adds to the counter already there. Burn ticks first, then Toxic, at the start of the owner's turn, before the draw. Burn's tick is unpierced, so Armor and Divine Shield take it; Toxic's tick pierces.
- "Damage also Burns N / applies Toxic N" (Mace, Reign, Zenith, Antumbra, Eclipse, the Rounds) adds N after each damage instance this deals to a Unit or hero that survives it.
- "Damage dealt Burns / is Toxic" (Volcanic Rounds, Noxious Rounds) replaces the damage: the target gains Burn or Toxic equal to the damage it would have taken, and takes none now.
- "Burn N an enemy unit" (Fire Beam) and "Toxic N an enemy unit / all enemies" (Scourge Mortar, Toxopid, Call to Chaos) are verbs that add N.
- **Default:** Vanilla clears both counters, and a Nerf does not: they are counters, not keywords a Nerf removes.

## The cards that will use it

S05 (Fire Beams, Scourge Mortars, the Rounds), S12 (Mace, Reign, Zenith, Antumbra, Eclipse), S13 (Toxopid), S24 (Call to Chaos).

## Done when

- [ ] The mechanic is written into the spec's sections it changes (§3, §4, §6, §10), with ruling notes numbered in this issue's block, tests named after them, and the paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- [ ] It is proved on fixture scripts in `crates/engine/tests/rules*` (the `testkit` feature's `scenario()`), with no card yet: the cards come in their own parts.
- [ ] The view (`view_for`) and the wire carry what it shows (`docs/v0.3.0/SURFACE.md` for any boundary it adds; `cargo test … --features jackioh-engine/ts` rewrites `apps/web/src/wire/`), and the client renders it.
- [ ] Every prompt it opens is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout. Every number is a named constant in `crates/engine/src/config.rs` (rule 9). The engine stays pure (rule 4).
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check` and `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` pass.
- [ ] Nothing changes for players: no shipped card reaches it unless this issue says so (and then a pending fragment claims that card).

Blocked by #3536

Part of #3534.
````
